drivers: Gulf of Mexico shut-ins and Saudi refinery strikes are bullish
Americas heavy-oil glut and wide Canadian crude discounts are bearish
outlooks.summary: Supply disruption headlines are mixed. Gulf storms and Middle East strikes support prices, but a heavy-oil glut in the Americas and the recent price drop offset them. The supply-pressure score is weak at +0.09.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how fast US Gulf output restarts and whether freight rates ease for heavy-oil flows.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应扰动消息多空交织。墨西哥湾风暴和中东袭击利多，但美洲重油过剩以及近期价格下跌起到抵消作用。供应压力得分仅为+0.09。
drivers_zh: 美国墨西哥湾停产和沙特炼厂遭袭偏多
美洲重油过剩、加拿大原油贴水扩大偏空
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾产量恢复速度以及重油运费是否回落。

drivers: Gold at 14-month low on Fed hike fears
outlooks.summary: No supply headlines. News is driven by macro and demand: Fed hike bets, a strong dollar and ETF outflows. This is not a supply-shortage story, and the risk is to the downside.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next Fed meeting and US dollar and yield moves.
outlooks.summary_zh: 没有供应方面的消息。市场由宏观和需求主导：美联储加息预期、美元走强和ETF资金流出。这不是供应短缺的情形，风险偏向下行。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧推动金价跌至14个月低点
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注下次美联储会议以及美元和收益率走势。

drivers: Congo quotas halve Glencore cobalt output
outlooks.summary: Congo export quotas and other export controls keep supply tight. The 24% fall in three months suggests some of this was priced out, but the shortage outlook still points up.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Congo quota adjustments and cobalt shipment data.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果出口配额及其他出口管制使供应保持紧张。三个月内价格下跌24%，说明部分利多已被消化，但短缺前景仍偏向上行。
drivers_zh: 刚果配额使嘉能可钴产量减半
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果配额调整和钴出货数据。

drivers: Chile copper output near 23-year low (moly by-product)
outlooks.summary: Few headlines are specific to molybdenum. Weak Chilean copper output could cut by-product supply, but the price has already risen sharply.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Chilean copper and moly mine output data.
outlooks.summary_zh: 几乎没有针对钼的消息。智利铜产量低迷可能减少副产钼供应，但价格已大幅上涨。
drivers_zh: 智利铜产量接近23年低点（钼为副产品）
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注智利铜矿和钼矿产量数据。

drivers: Zimbabwe lithium export tax, local sourcing rules and 2027 export ban
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe's policy moves and India's black mass ban point to tighter export flows. The 2027 ban is not immediate, and prices are well above last year, so the effect over 1-3 months is limited.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Zimbabwe delays or confirms the 2027 export ban.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦的政策举措和印度的黑粉出口禁令指向出口流动收紧。2027年禁令并非立即生效，且价格同比已大幅上涨，对未来1-3个月的影响有限。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦锂出口税、本地采购规定及2027年出口禁令
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦是推迟还是确认2027年出口禁令。

drivers: Thailand bans chemicals for Myanmar rare earth mining
Laos suspends operations after dam breach
outlooks.summary: China's wider export controls, Thailand's chemical ban affecting Myanmar mining and a Laos suspension all cut supply. China's extension of the suspension on some controls to 2027 is a partial offset. Japan's yttrium price surge shows real shortages.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Chinese export licence data and Myanmar output after Thailand's ban.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国扩大出口管制、泰国禁止向缅甸稀土开采出口化学品、老挝暂停作业，均削减供应。中国将部分管制措施的暂停期延长至2027年，可部分抵消。日本氧化钇价格飙升显示出实际短缺。
drivers_zh: 泰国禁止向缅甸稀土开采出口化学品
老挝溃坝后暂停稀土作业
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口许可数据以及泰国禁令后缅甸的产量。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeeze supply
Myanmar mining-chemical export ban by Thailand
outlooks.summary: Conflict in Congo, cuts in Indonesia and Myanmar-related disruption keep supply tight. Prices are already high, but the 3-month change is flat, so there is room for more upside.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and Congo mine status.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突、印尼减产以及缅甸相关扰动使供应保持紧张。价格已处高位，但3个月涨幅持平，仍有上行空间。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产加剧供应紧张
泰国对缅甸采矿化学品的出口禁令
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量和刚果矿山状况。

drivers: Major Chinese antimony mine halts production
China's US export ban suspension nears expiry
outlooks.summary: A major mine stoppage in China and the approaching end of the export ban suspension point to tighter supply. Prices have fallen a lot, so there is room for a rebound.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether China extends its suspension of the US export ban and when the mine restarts.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国一座大型锑矿停产，且对美出口禁令暂停期即将到期，供应趋紧。价格已大幅下跌，存在反弹空间。
drivers_zh: 中国一座大型锑矿停产
中国对美出口禁令暂停期临近到期
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国是否延长对美出口禁令的暂停期以及该矿何时复产。

drivers: Governments racing to fund ex-China supply
outlooks.summary: Export controls continue to limit supply and non-China capacity will take time. The price has already jumped sharply, so part of the shortage may be priced in, but supply risk remains.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Chinese export licence data and new ex-China project funding.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口管制持续限制供应，中国以外的产能需要时间建设。价格已大幅上涨，部分短缺可能已被计价，但供应风险依然存在。
drivers_zh: 各国政府竞相资助中国以外产能
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口许可数据及中国以外新项目的融资进展。

drivers: Gulf of Mexico shut-ins and Saudi refinery strikes
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mixed and the supply-pressure score is weak at +0.09. Gulf storms and Middle East strikes are bullish, but the heavy-oil glut offsets them. Price is already up 15%.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf output recovery and green coke availability.
outlooks.summary_zh: 消息多空交织，供应压力得分偏弱，仅为+0.09。墨西哥湾风暴和中东袭击利多，但重油过剩起抵消作用。价格已上涨15%。
drivers_zh: 美国墨西哥湾停产和沙特炼厂遭袭
石油焦上涨使其对煤炭的折价收窄
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾产量恢复和生焦供应情况。

drivers: Gulf of Mexico shut-ins and Middle East refinery strikes
outlooks.summary: Supply headlines are mixed and the score is weak at +0.09. Disruptions are offset by a heavy-oil glut in the Americas, so there is no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf refinery restarts and Middle East attacks on refineries.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应消息多空交织，得分偏弱，仅为+0.09。供应扰动被美洲重油过剩抵消，没有明确的短缺信号。
drivers_zh: 美国墨西哥湾停产和中东炼厂遭袭
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾炼厂复产以及中东对炼厂的袭击。
